text:
maria gonzalez: Hey payments team — saw a Venmo-originated refund flagged as duplicate authorization on acct redwood-inc-438. Chargeback risk? TXN 0x9f7a2b. Anyone pulling evidence?
josh-payments: I see it in the gateway. Two auths for $42.50 within 3s, second marked as reversal by Venmo. Could be double-capture or client retry.
payments-bot: Alert: chargeback_risk=HIGH customer_id=438 txn=0x9f7a2b score=78%
eric-ops: Can we get the merchant settlement file + webhook logs? Need to confirm if both auths reached acquirer. Also share the card last4 and AVS/AVS-match.
sarah-support: Customer says they only clicked once and provided a Venmo screenshot showing a single completed payment. Uploading now.
josh-payments: Pulling logs and settlement CSV now. Preparing an evidence bundle to send to acquirer and Venmo ops.
josh-payments: ```txn_id=0x9f7a2b
auth_ts=2025-11-01T14:02:33Z
reversal_ts=2025-11-01T14:02:36Z
settle_id=SET-991122
amount=42.50```
maria gonzalez: Include device fingerprint, IPs, user-agent strings, and billing address match. If we have a prefix KV cache entry for that session, add it.
eric-ops: Also ask the vendor (Venmo ops) for dispute reason code and whether they consider this an issuer-initiated soft decline/reversal vs. merchant-side duplicate.
sarah-support: Posted customer screenshot link: https://redwood-secure-screenshots/438/venmo-snap.png — no extra charges visible on app.
josh-payments: Bundle ready — settlement CSV + webhook log + customer screenshot + gateway trace. Will submit to acquirer and cc Venmo ops.
maria gonzalez: Thanks. If acquirer pushes chargeback, we need to respond within 30 days. Mark this thread for follow-up and set reminder 48h. :clock1:
payments-bot: Evidence bundle uploaded to case CASE-2025-438. Response deadline in 30 days.
eric-ops: Good. If anything changes (more duplicates or pattern), escalate to fraud team and consider temporary account hold for high-risk merchant.
sarah-support: Noted. Will keep the customer updated with "we've escalated to payments ops" message. :thumbsup:
